_about: Constants used by make_figures.py that no banked JSON artifact records as a number. Each carries its source; the script asserts them against the artifacts wherever an artifact allows it.

crosstalk_bar.source: V-95 and V-163 preregistrations: the arena-C frozen-state probe (v13_logs/v13_fixed.json arm floor, mean 0.5153, fixed as 0.515) plus 0.10; figdata/v163_logs/v163_score.out: 'largest tested cross-talk clearing 0.615 is 0.2486'

capacity_criterion.source: the frozen scorer of V-151 (ngcls/v151_score.py: THRESH, BOOT, BOOT_SEED), as repeated in reference_v54/make_figs_v2.py; the 0.70 crossing is interpolated linearly in log k between the two grid points that bracket it

ledger.source: V-151 ledger values quoted in reference_v54/FIGURES_v52_notes.md (sweeps panel d); make_figures.py asserts that it reproduces them

pool.source: v106_logs/v106.json config.n_pool = 400; v101.py, v102.py and v149.py call load_rows(400); pooled() (v100.py) stops when the other instances' gold triples run out, two per compositional instance (v73_logs/v73_BANKED.json: 600 bindings from 300 instances). A scale requested as 1024 therefore holds 800 facts. The realized pool size is not recorded in v102_scored.json, v151.json or v106.json; make_figures.py checks it against the prompt lengths of v106.json (tokens grow linearly in the number of facts)
